retrievalProfile.description: A central illustrated portrait framed by a vibrant, multi-colored stained glass circular halo with arched sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: arched sans-serif title over circular graphic

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized illustration of a woman with a high bun and braid, positioned in front of a complex, concentric stained glass window design featuring pink, blue, and yellow panes. The entire composition is set against a textured magenta background with text following the curve of the central circle.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject is centered and framed by the circular stained glass halo.
The primary text arches perfectly along the top curve of the halo.
The magenta background provides a high-contrast field for the teal and yellow elements.
Concentric circles create a sense of depth and focus on the subject's face.
coreInvariants: Concentric circular stained glass pattern behind the subject
Arched typography following the upper radius of the circle
High-contrast magenta and teal color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The female subject is centrally located, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame at a medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central face and the bright yellow inner ring of the stained glass circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move upward to the arched title, and then circulate around the stained glass patterns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and sides consist of a textured magenta field, providing breathing room for the dense central graphic.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and Gold (inner halo and glass highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary hues with dark black linework defining the glass segments.

letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the primary name is slightly enlarged for emphasis.

composition.relationshipToImage: frames the top of the graphic

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary smaller sans-serif is used for metadata in the corners to maintain a clean, modern look.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and clarity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an illustration of a woman with a high bun and braid in a teal shirt, centered in front of a vibrant concentric stained glass circular window. The background should be a textured magenta. Leave the top arc of the circle clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in a bold geometric sans-serif, colored teal, following a 180-degree arch path that matches the top curve of the stained glass window.

verificationChecks: Is the stained glass pattern concentric?
Is the background a textured magenta?

mustAchieve: Clean geometric linework in the glass

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's head.
Verify the stained glass segments have consistent black outlines.
Check that the magenta background has a subtle paper-like texture.
Confirm the teal text is legible against the magenta.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Concentric Stained Glass Halo + Arched Geometric Sans-Serif Title + Magenta/Teal Palette
